correctness.rationale: TARGET deductive proof verified step-by-step: triangulated lemma c^2=0 and c=0 criterion correct; [V(0),S]=0 via pi1(S)_{(3)}=0 gives 3*id_{V(0)}=0; hence 9*id_{V(1)}=0. Low 3-local stems pi0-pi6 and LES values pi0V0=Z/3, pi4V0=Z/3, pi5=pi6=0 verified against standard stable stems (Z/24 gives Z/3, Z/2 localizes to 0). Endomorphism groups [V0,S^1]=Z/3, [V0,V0]=Z/3, [Sigma^4V0,V0]=Z/3, [Sigma^5V0,V0]=0 verified via correct LES segments. Then [V1,V0]=ker v1^*=0 for essential v1 (BP_*/3 nonzero) and split null-v1 case also gives 3*id=0. Hence all stems F3-vector spaces, V1 noncontractible via BP_*/(3,v1)!=0 pins exp=1. No experimental gap.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal Perplexity check returned 20 results with only 1 base overlap. I body-inspected every retained candidate via proxy PDF download plus pdftotext: HHA L2-V1 correction, Annals K(2)-local sphere paper, Behrens modular K(2)-local paper and its mirror, Shimomura author list, THH mod-(p,v1) paper, Pham dissertation (mandatory), J-STAGE L2-Moore paper, v2-periodic/synthetic paper, EChG24-A1 dissertation-adjacent paper, chromatic E1-term paper, Belmont-Shimomura beta-families paper, Shimo-Wang L2S0 paper, K(2)-local Moore paper, Kato beta-elements paper, Picard-group paper, and chromatic course notes. Three cached results were excluded as neither substantively relevant after literal claim comparison nor mandatory escalations: the Nakazawa-Shimomura type-one page (own object L2M wedge X, type-one, V(1) only inside a cited work; direct PDF 404), and the Henn centralizers mirror plus OUCI publisher page (own object profinite-group cohomology; V(1)-at-3 only as background cited works; publisher PDF bot-blocked, mirror failed). None of the three shares the V(1)+prime-3 base pair as its own theorem, none states any identity exponent, and none is a dissertation, so this documented exclusion is not a silent omission. All retained sources prove L2/K(2)-local computations, periodic-map existence, THH homology, Picard structure, or background definitions; hidden Z/9 extensions mean none states or implies integral 3*id_{V(1)}=0. The check added useful incremental negative evidence but no decisive prior; all three axis verdicts and the public package are preserved with no verdict change.
